# Tools

<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-START -->
<!-- A short orientation for this page; task guidance belongs under Use. Kept across regeneration. -->
The tools reach Paperless with the token this server is configured with, so
they see and change only what that token's Paperless user may.

**Pages.** Every list tool returns one page, with `next` and `previous` as
bare `page=N` markers, or `null` at either end. Pass `page=N` to fetch
another. The markers never carry the Paperless host name.

**Paperless versions.** Requests prefer Paperless payload version 10. When
Paperless rejects that version, the client session falls back to version 9 for
Paperless 2.x. An authentication, permission or other failure never triggers
the fallback. After upgrading a connected 2.x instance, restart this server to
select version 10 again.

**Errors.** A tool that cannot deliver its result returns a tool error written
for the model: what went wrong and which call to make next. How it is logged
depends on who has to act:

| Paperless answered | The model is told | Logged at |
|---|---|---|
| 400, 403, another 4xx, or 404 for an id the call passed | what to change, or that the account may not do this | `INFO` |
| 409 | to read the object again and retry with its current values | `INFO` |
| 429, 5xx, or no answer | the request was fine; retry in a minute | `WARNING` |
| 401, 404 for a call without an id, or a reply the server cannot parse | the request was fine; tell the user | `ERROR` |

Only the last row needs an operator. Anything else that fails inside a tool is
logged once as `tool_failed` at `ERROR` with its traceback.
<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-END -->

Every tool runs with the server's own privileges; the [security model](../../security-model.md) says what that reaches.

| Group | Tool | Title | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Documents | [`list_documents`](documents.md#list_documents) | List Documents | List documents filtered by their metadata; returns one page of metadata. |
| Documents | [`search_documents`](documents.md#search_documents) | Search Documents | Search the full text and metadata of documents; returns one page, best match first. |
| Documents | [`get_document`](documents.md#get_document) | Get Document | Get one document's metadata, notes and custom field values, without its text. |
| Documents | [`get_document_content`](documents.md#get_document_content) | Get Document Text | Read a document's text, up to 20,000 characters per call. |
| Documents | [`get_document_thumbnail`](documents.md#get_document_thumbnail) | Get Document Thumbnail | Get a small image of a document's first page. |
| Documents | [`get_document_metadata`](documents.md#get_document_metadata) | Get Document File Details | Get a document's file details: original and archived file names, sizes, checksums and MIME type. |
| Documents | [`get_document_notes`](documents.md#get_document_notes) | List Document Notes | List the notes on a document, with their full text. |
| Documents | [`get_document_history`](documents.md#get_document_history) | Get Document Audit Log | List the changes made to a document: who changed which field, and when. |
| Documents | [`get_document_suggestions`](documents.md#get_document_suggestions) | Suggest Tags, Correspondent and Type | Get Paperless's suggested tags, correspondent, document type and dates for a document. |
| Documents | [`update_document`](documents.md#update_document) | Update Document | Change a document's metadata; returns the updated document without its text. |
| Documents | [`delete_document`](documents.md#delete_document) | Move Document to Trash | Move a document to Paperless's trash, where a user can restore it until the trash is emptied. |
| Documents | [`upload_document`](documents.md#upload_document) | Upload Document | Upload a file for Paperless to consume; returns the consume task's id. |
| Documents | [`bulk_edit_documents`](documents.md#bulk_edit_documents) | Bulk Edit Documents | Apply one operation to many documents at once; returns OK once Paperless accepts it. |
| Documents | [`add_document_note`](documents.md#add_document_note) | Add Document Note | Add a note to a document; returns the new note with its id. |
| Documents | [`delete_document_note`](documents.md#delete_document_note) | Delete Document Note | Delete one note from a document. |
| Tags | [`list_tags`](tags.md#list_tags) | List Tags | List tags; returns one page with their ids and names. |
| Tags | [`get_tag`](tags.md#get_tag) | Get Tag | Get one tag by id. |
| Tags | [`create_tag`](tags.md#create_tag) | Create Tag | Create a tag; returns it with its id. |
| Tags | [`update_tag`](tags.md#update_tag) | Update Tag | Change a tag's name, colour, inbox flag or matching rule; returns the tag. |
| Tags | [`delete_tag`](tags.md#delete_tag) | Delete Tag | Delete a tag and remove it from every document that carries it. |
| Tags | [`bulk_edit_tags`](tags.md#bulk_edit_tags) | Bulk Edit Tags | Set the owner and permissions of many tags, or delete them; returns OK when applied. |
| Correspondents | [`list_correspondents`](correspondents.md#list_correspondents) | List Correspondents | List correspondents; returns one page with their ids and names. |
| Correspondents | [`get_correspondent`](correspondents.md#get_correspondent) | Get Correspondent | Get one correspondent by id. |
| Correspondents | [`create_correspondent`](correspondents.md#create_correspondent) | Create Correspondent | Create a correspondent; returns it with its id. |
| Correspondents | [`update_correspondent`](correspondents.md#update_correspondent) | Update Correspondent | Change a correspondent's name or matching rule; returns the updated correspondent. |
| Correspondents | [`delete_correspondent`](correspondents.md#delete_correspondent) | Delete Correspondent | Delete a correspondent and clear it from every document that names it. |
| Correspondents | [`bulk_edit_correspondents`](correspondents.md#bulk_edit_correspondents) | Bulk Edit Correspondents | Set the owner and permissions of many correspondents, or delete them; returns OK when applied. |
| Document types | [`list_document_types`](document_types.md#list_document_types) | List Document Types | List document types; returns one page with their ids and names. |
| Document types | [`get_document_type`](document_types.md#get_document_type) | Get Document Type | Get one document type by id. |
| Document types | [`create_document_type`](document_types.md#create_document_type) | Create Document Type | Create a document type; returns it with its id. |
| Document types | [`update_document_type`](document_types.md#update_document_type) | Update Document Type | Change a document type's name or matching rule; returns the updated document type. |
| Document types | [`delete_document_type`](document_types.md#delete_document_type) | Delete Document Type | Delete a document type and clear it from every document of that type. |
| Document types | [`bulk_edit_document_types`](document_types.md#bulk_edit_document_types) | Bulk Edit Document Types | Set the owner and permissions of many document types, or delete them; returns OK when applied. |
| Custom fields | [`list_custom_fields`](custom_fields.md#list_custom_fields) | List Custom Fields | List custom field definitions; returns one page with their ids, names and types. |
| Custom fields | [`get_custom_field`](custom_fields.md#get_custom_field) | Get Custom Field | Get one custom field definition by id, with its select options. |
| Custom fields | [`create_custom_field`](custom_fields.md#create_custom_field) | Create Custom Field | Define a new custom field; returns it with its id. |
| Custom fields | [`update_custom_field`](custom_fields.md#update_custom_field) | Update Custom Field | Rename a custom field or change its options; returns the updated field. |
| Custom fields | [`delete_custom_field`](custom_fields.md#delete_custom_field) | Delete Custom Field | Delete a custom field and its value on every document. |
| Storage paths | [`list_storage_paths`](storage_paths.md#list_storage_paths) | List Storage Paths | List storage paths, the folder layouts Paperless files documents into; returns one page. |
| Storage paths | [`get_storage_path`](storage_paths.md#get_storage_path) | Get Storage Path | Get one storage path by id, with its path template. |
| Saved views | [`list_saved_views`](saved_views.md#list_saved_views) | List Saved Views | List saved views, the named document filters users keep in Paperless; returns one page. |
| Saved views | [`get_saved_view`](saved_views.md#get_saved_view) | Get Saved View | Get one saved view by id, with its filter rules and sort order. |
| Share links | [`list_share_links`](share_links.md#list_share_links) | List Share Links | List public share links for documents; returns one page with each link's document, expiry and URL. |
| Share links | [`get_share_link`](share_links.md#get_share_link) | Get Share Link | Get one share link by id, with its document, expiry and URL. |
| Tasks | [`list_tasks`](tasks.md#list_tasks) | List Background Tasks | List Paperless background tasks such as consuming uploads and reindexing; returns one page, newest first. |
| Tasks | [`get_task`](tasks.md#get_task) | Get Background Task | Get one background task by id, with its status and result; returns null if there is none. |
| Tasks | [`wait_for_task`](tasks.md#wait_for_task) | Wait for Task to Finish | Wait for a background task to finish; returns the task with its final status and result. |
| System | [`get_statistics`](system.md#get_statistics) | Get Paperless Statistics | Get counts for the whole archive: documents, inbox documents, tags, correspondents, types, characters and file types. |
| System | [`get_remote_version`](system.md#get_remote_version) | Check for Paperless Updates | Check whether a newer Paperless-NGX release exists; returns the newest release. |
| Server info | [`get_server_info`](server_info.md#get_server_info) | Server Info | Report the version information of paperless-mcp; returns `server_name`, `server_version`, `core_version`, the MCP protocol revisions supported and the revision and client of this connection, and, when configured, the upstream service's version. |
| Transfer | [`create_download_link`](transfer.md#create_download_link) | Create Download Link | Create a download URL for a file; returns url and `expires_in_s`. |
| Transfer | [`create_upload_link`](transfer.md#create_upload_link) | Create Upload Link | Create an upload URL for a file; returns url and `expires_in_s`. |
